explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/859: Erdős proved that d_t exists and 1/(log t)^{c₃} < d_t < 1/(log t)^{c₄} for some c₃, c₄ > 0. DivisorSumSet t is the set of n for which t is a sum of distinct divisors of n. The statement asserts, for all large t, a density d_t strictly between those bounds. The extra existential t₀ is unused but harmless. Faithful.
